blocks.title: MCP coverage for this service
blocks.intro: The CDGC Metadata Search MCP server covers this service. Two actions. One of them is the single most important thing MCP has that REST does not: get_asset_details returns LINEAGE, which no REST endpoint on this platform will give you.
rows: Natural-language catalog query returning matching asset IDs and core attributes.
Wraps POST /data360/search/api/v1/search. REST is richer: raw Elasticsearch DSL.
Full metadata for one asset, INCLUDING lineage, profile and descriptions.
MCP ONLY for lineage. Every REST lineage path returns 404.
